details: Built a middleware application bridging Salesforce Marketing Cloud and a messaging platform using Express.js and Nuxt.js.
Enabled businesses to run marketing campaigns and send up to 10,000 messages per minute.
Developed the front end of a Japanese media platform using Next.js, enabling over 400 emerging startups to connect with potential investors.
Migrated and developed modules for the company's latest Odoo ERP system, optimizing accounting, payroll, inventory purchase, recruitment, meal ordering, and leave management for over 500 employees.
Performed technical interviews and assessments for roughly 100 candidates to recruit software engineers who met company standards.
Trained 10 software engineer trainees in Python, Django, and Odoo.
